objective: Locate and test relational estimators with explicit nuisance parameters. No presumed equality of measured channel b or squeeze rho with betaTGL.

models.assumptions: Two inputs, common symmetric lossless power transfer [[1-b,b],[b,1-b]], positive unknown input intensities IA,IB, fixed positive port gains g1,g2, backgrounds removed, 0<b<1.
models.claim: sqrt(Q)=b/(1-b), b=sqrt(Q)/(1+sqrt(Q)); no target beta input.
models.falsifiers: Symbolic residual nonzero; injected channel b not recovered. Single configuration with unknown gains must be nonidentifiable; configuration-dependent gains must break recovery.

models.assumptions: R59 pure zero-mean two-mode squeezed input; independent vacuum loss etaA,etaB in (0,1]; calibrated photon units; no extra additive noise, mixing or phase jitter; n>0.
models.claim: n=x*y/d; etaA=d/y; etaB=d/x. Local identifiability with determinant nonzero. This does not yield beta.
models.falsifiers: Exact reconstruction fails; boundary d<=0 must refuse; arbitrary mixed input must permit indistinguishable states, including ones passing ideal-domain checks.

verification: SymPy exact identities and rational synthetic controls; numerical checks only if named and tolerance fixed. No observed data, no 5-sigma or empirical power claim.
scope: R5 readout/covariance component only. R4 recovery, OH generator and clock unchanged; no accepted mission requirement.
